<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex081012026-08-2003-46-00" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">ho</rs> na re mngon pa 'thad pa thad mod 'chad cin do dgsa pa gtan la 'bems pa yin pas mdo la 2 pas rta ba lta bu'i md gtan la 'bebs pa pa'i dngos gzhi 'brel pa g bug med rten
<lb n="N003"/>
la 'bebs pa gzhan 4 co |
<rs type="person">'dang</rs> na re snga ma 'thad mchems pa'i lo rgyus dang bsdun na po'i 'thad per | bsu ba'i los stom rnam pa 2a ni thag pa khun mong gi sdom kun las btus pa tsung ma yin pa'i skom chen bsdu'o || 
<rs type="person">'can</rs> na re s ste nas theg pa sun gi chos theg pa chen pob chos 'thor nas yod pa phyogs 1 du bsdus nas ston pa yin zer ro bo mdo na rseg pa sdin dang theg len gyi chos 'thar nas yod pa phyogs
<lb n="N004"/>
a du bsdus pa la stom 2 chod <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dbyig nyen</rs> gyis mdhad pa'i dra ka ra na ste myad ni phu po lngas rebsu byed pa nyi bu pa sum bcu g las grub pa'i rigs pa <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8438">rnam bshad rigs pa</rs> rten 'brel gyi mdo 'gre li dang po dang ba ma rnam par 'byed pa'i mdos gral pa sol 1a rten 'brel chen pos do ka cer te de ni btsun pa ston blo gros kyis byas co || </seg></TEI>
